generation.postProcess: remove_chroma_key.py --auto-key border --soft-matte --transparent-threshold 12 --opaque-threshold 220 --despill; detect exactly 30 connected alpha components per master; isolate every component with its antialias fringe; apply one shared fit scale per creature row; center six independent frames in 256x192 cells; compose a 1536x192 strip
